page.layout: One block: the front board of a leather binding. Faded stamped lettering at the top centre, a blind-stamped ornamental panel in the centre, faded lettering at the bottom centre, and two metal clasps on the right edge. No page text.
page.notes: This is the front cover of the binding, not a printed page. The top lettering is worn gilt or stamped type, and only a few letters can be made out, including a possible Greek ΔΙΟ. The bottom reads roughly "M" followed by illegible letters and a final "K", possibly a date, but this is uncertain. The central panel is a blind-stamped ornament with no text. The two clasps and the leather damage are not printed matter and are not transcribed.
